Director, Business Systems
Aurora Solar
Administration · Full-time
United States
Posted on Oct 24, 2026
Apply now
About Aurora Solar
Aurora is on a mission to create a future of solar for all. Our award-winning software puts the power of data and technology into the hands of every solar professional to make solar adoption simple and predictable. Our software has designed millions of solar projects so far, empowering solar companies to sell, design, and install residential and commercial solar arrays accurately, seamlessly, and at scale. 
We’ve been named one of "The Best Remote Companies" by BuiltIn.com and have been recognized for the second time as a Certified Green Business (CGB) with the city of San Francisco. We’re in this together to support the world’s transition to solar.
About the Team
Business Systems sits within Finance and powers how Aurora goes to market, sells, bills, and recognizes revenue. The team covers RevOps systems, usage and billing, and marketing operations. Together they support everything from first lead to cash collected for both sales-led and self-serve customers. We partner closely with Accounts Receivable, FP&A, Deal Desk, Sales, Marketing, Data Analytics and Product teams to ensure our systems evolve alongside the ways Aurora sells and monetizes its offerings. We’re building a scalable, well-documented stack that can support new products, pricing models, and geographies as Aurora grows.
About the Role
We’re hiring a Director of Business Systems to lead the systems that power Aurora’s quote-to-cash, go-to-market, and finance operations. You’ll lead a small, experienced team and own how HubSpot, Salesforce, Continuous, Zuora, NetSuite, and the broader commercial technology stack work together to support our business.
In this hands-on leadership role, you’ll define the systems architecture and roadmap, partnering closely with leaders across Finance, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product to align on priorities. You’ll stay close to system configuration, bringing the technical depth to unblock your team and make informed trade-offs.
What you’ll own 
Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Revenue Cloud/RCA) 
Continuous 
Zuora 
NetSuite 
Gainsight 
HubSpot 
Integrations and Snowflake data flows 
Other RevOps tools 
Your Impact 
Automate quote-to-cash for sales-led and self-serve purchases across geographies, ensuring usage, billing, and renewals flow seamlessly through Salesforce, Continuous, Zuora, and NetSuite with clean data and no manual intervention 
Build a scalable systems architecture that supports new campaigns, products, pricing models, and geographies without custom workarounds 
Serve as a strategic partner to Finance and GTM leaders 
Develop a self-organizing team that leverages automation and AI to manage intake, backlog, and prioritization, while balancing urgent fixes with roadmap delivery 
Document and streamline our processes and systems architecture, identify gaps and edge cases, and use these insights to prioritize improvements that support scale 
Simplify the technology stack and reduce costs by consolidating platforms and retiring tools we’ve outgrown 
Own systems governance, vendor relationships, and the team’s budget, including SOX-ready controls and practical applications of AI 
What You Bring 
12+ years of experience in business systems, revenue operations systems, or finance systems, including 4+ years leading teams 
Deep, hands-on experience with Salesforce (CPQ or Revenue Cloud) and a subscription billing platform such as Zuora; along with working knowledge of NetSuite or a comparable ERP 
A strong understanding of quote-to-cash and order-to-revenue processes in a B2B SaaS business, including usage-based or hybrid pricing 
A track record of leading system and billing implementations, migrations, integrations, or re-architectures from requirements definition through rollout 
Experience managing change management and release processes, including environment management, testing, and disciplined deployment practices 
Experience establishing data governance and hygiene standards across CRM, billing, and ERP systems 
The ability to explain technical trade-offs to Finance and GTM executives in clear, accessible language 
Experience establishing intake, sprint, or backlog practices for a systems team 
Sound judgment on when to configure, customize, integrate, or adapt the underlying process 
Experience managing contractors, systems vendors, and implementation partners within budget, including statements of work (SOWs) and renewals 
Familiarity with revenue recognition (ASC 606) and SOX IT general controls as they apply to finance systems 
Nice to Haves 
Experience in solar, energy, or other hardware-adjacent SaaS markets 
Experience supporting self-serve or product-led purchasing alongside a sales-led motion 
Experience configuring systems for international expansion, including multi-currency, multi-entity, and regional tax requirements 
Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RCA), Continuous, or similar usage-metering tools 
Familiarity with marketing automation platforms and lead-to-opportunity processes 
Salesforce, Zuora, or NetSuite certifications 
What We Offer 
🏖️Flexible PTO 
🍼Parental Leave 
💰WFH Stipend 
🏢 Coworking Stipend 
☀️Energize Fridays 
📶Connectivity Stipend 
Learning & Development 
🩺Medical, Dental, and Vision 
Please take a look at our U.S. Benefits Booklet for a deeper dive into our offerings
Where Aurorans are: Aurora currently has teams within the US, Canada, Poland, UK and Germany with additional locations on the horizon. We’re united in our work to support the world’s transition to solar!
Aurora is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workforce of people who believe in and are passionate about creating a future of solar energy for all. We are an equal opportunity employer, we welcome and consider qualified applicants regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. We encourage you to apply even if you believe that you do not meet all of the above criteria!
Aurora is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation that would better enable your success during the application or interview process, please complete this form.
